title: 第019章 七村涤瘴消沉疴遍积功德润琴根第020章 功成归宗受嘉赏音律古阁引灵鸣
content_zh:
老郎中站在一旁，瞪大了双眼。
捋着胡须连连惊叹。
他行医半生，见过丹师炼药、修士驱邪，却从未见过如此温润又霸道的疗愈手段。
无形音波一荡，顽疾尽消，邪祟全无！
当真神乎其技。
王磊则自觉地守在院落门口，维持秩序，不让无关人等打扰蔡文姬施法。
有村民想要上前道谢，他都轻轻摆手示意，低声道：
“大家稍等。让师妹专心治病。等所有人都好了再道谢不迟。”
蔡文姬没有停歇，脚步不停，沿着一间间土屋缓缓走动。
维持着大范围疗愈音波。
炼气二层的灵气储备本就因之前的透支所剩无几。
此刻更是飞速消耗。
她的脸色一点点变得苍白，指尖开始微微颤抖。
额角的冷汗顺着脸颊滑落，滴落在衣襟上。
有村民注意到她的异样。
忍不住小声说道。
“仙长姑娘好像很累的样子……要不先歇会儿吧，我们不急。”
蔡文姬闻言，轻轻摇了摇头。
她能感觉到，那些孩童和老人的神魂，已经被魔渊浊气侵蚀得十分严重。
若是中途停下，恐怕会留下永久的损伤。

她咬紧牙关，再次催动体内仅剩的功德之力。
将【思无邪】的净化效果拉到最大。
淡白色的光幕骤然亮了几分，那些顽固的魔渊浊气。
终于被一点点彻底拔除。
飞来飞去的梦奇也跟着加大了吸力，圆滚滚的小肚子鼓得像个皮球，却还是不肯停下。
“文姬文姬，我超能吃！你别累着喔！”
半个时辰后。
整片清溪村的阴邪病气被彻底清扫一空。
所有卧床不起的病患，全都能够自行起身行走。
面色红润，精气神十足。
萦绕村落多日的灰色瘴气被音律之力彻底驱散！
明媚的阳光穿透云层，完整地洒落在街巷之间。
笼罩清溪村半月之久的阴霾，终于一朝散尽。
就在这时。
蔡文姬再也支撑不住，身体猛地一晃，一口淡黑色的淤血从嘴角溢出。
那是刚才强行净化魔渊浊气，积攒在体内的反噬之力。
“蔡师妹！”王磊大惊失色，连忙冲上前扶住她。
“文姬文姬！”
梦奇也瞬间飞了过来，扑到她的嘴边，一口把那丝黑血吸进肚子里。
content_en:
The old doctor stood aside, his eyes widened.
He stroked his beard and marveled again and again.
He has practiced medicine for half his life and has seen alchemists refining medicine and monks exorcising evil spirits, but he has never seen such gentle and overbearing healing methods.
As soon as the invisible sound wave ripples, all stubborn illnesses disappear and all evil spirits disappear!
It's really amazing.
Wang Lei consciously stood at the entrance of the courtyard to maintain order and prevent irrelevant people from disturbing Cai Wenji's spellcasting.
When any villager wanted to come forward to say thank you, he gently waved his hand and said in a low voice:
"Everyone, wait a moment. Let Junior Sister concentrate on treating the illness. It's not too late to say thank you after everyone is well."
Cai Wenji didn't stop, she kept walking, walking slowly along the earthen houses.
Maintains large-scale healing sound waves.
The spiritual energy reserve on the second level of Qi Refining was already running low due to the previous overdraft.
At this moment, it is even more consumed rapidly.
Her face turned pale little by little, and her fingertips began to tremble slightly.
The cold sweat on his forehead slid down his cheeks and dripped on his clothes.
Some villagers noticed something strange about her.
Couldn't help but whisper.
"Miss Fairy looks very tired... Why don't you take a rest first, we are not in a hurry."
When Cai Wenji heard this, she shook her head slightly.
She could feel that the souls of those children and old people had been severely eroded by the turbid energy of the demonic abyss.
If you stop midway, you may be left with permanent damage.
She gritted her teeth and once again activated the remaining merit power in her body.
Maximize the purification effect of [Siwuxie].
The pale white light curtain suddenly brightened a bit, revealing those stubborn demonic abyss turbidity.
Finally it was completely removed bit by bit.
Mengqi, who was flying around, also increased the suction force, his round belly bulging like a ball, but he still refused to stop.
"Wenji Wenji, I can eat so much! Don't be too tired!"
Half an hour later.
The entire Qingxi Village was completely wiped out of all evil and disease.
All bedridden patients were able to get up and walk on their own.
Her face is ruddy and full of energy.
The gray miasma that had lingered in the village for many days was completely dispelled by the power of music!
The bright sunshine penetrated the clouds and fell completely on the streets.
The haze that had shrouded Qingxi Village for half a month finally dissipated.
Just then.
Cai Wenji could no longer hold on, her body swayed suddenly, and a mouthful of light black blood spilled from the corner of her mouth.
That was the backlash power accumulated in the body after forcibly purifying the turbid energy from the Demonic Abyss just now.
"Junior Sister Cai!" Wang Lei was shocked and rushed forward to support her.
"Wenji Wenji!"
Meng Qi also flew over in an instant, rushed to her mouth, and sucked the black blood into her stomach.
